scope: 42 paired interpretation outputs; A/B identities independently randomized for every query; no identities, timing, trial logs or model mappings inspected
limitations: Provisional intent judgements, not human acceptance.
No retrieved titles or ranked-result outcomes were available.
Soft attribute labels do not establish hard filter enforcement.
Concrete lists show no polarity or downstream routing; flagged negative-term risks require pipeline confirmation.
No model identity or aggregate winner is inferred here.
